name: Cuaca Weather
author: rafiyq
description: BMKG weather pill with detail popup (cuaca.wilayah.workers.dev), worldwide fallback

barWidget.description: BMKG weather pill with detail popup (cuaca.wilayah.workers.dev), worldwide fallback

schema.label: Condition language
schema.description: BMKG condition wording: native Indonesian (id) or the English alias (en).

schema.label: Icon set
schema.description: Icon style for the pill, today strip, and forecast row: Nerd Font glyphs (nerd) or emoji.

schema.label: Temperature unit
schema.description: Metric or Fahrenheit; auto follows the forecast location's country first, then the system locale.

schema.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
schema.description: How often the widget re-fetches weather data.
